message.subject: Collaboration with EDXSO
message.email_body: Figuring out how to properly navigate software updates and hidden features on tablets can often feel overwhelming for students and learners trying to stay productive. Your video on One UI 8.5 Features You Need to Know caught our attention recently. EDXSO works with schools on academic outcomes, leadership and sustainable institutional growth, and we are planning an exploratory sponsored walkthrough video for teachers and school leaders, with format and terms to be discussed. Please reply if a short call this month would suit you.
message.dm: Hi honeybeam planner, your Samsung tablet tips caught our attention. We are exploring an educational resource collaboration with EDXSO and would love to connect.
